title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
description: Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints. An attacker who can control log messages or log message parameters can execute arbitrary code loaded from LDAP servers when message lookup substitution is enabled.
kevVulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
kevRequiredAction: Apply updates per vendor instructions or remove the JndiLookup class from the classpath.

title: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection
description: A command injection vulnerability in web components of Ivanti Connect Secure (9.x, 22.x) and Ivanti Policy Secure allows an authenticated administrator to send specially crafted requests and execute arbitrary commands on the appliance.
kevVulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
kevRequiredAction: Apply vendor mitigation and immediate patching.

title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection in GlobalProtect
description: A command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software for specific PAN-OS versions and distinct feature configurations may enable an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.
kevVulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection Vulnerability

title: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection
description: In Progress MOVEit Transfer before 2021.0.6 (13.0.6), 2021.1.4 (13.1.4), 2022.0.4 (14.0.4), 2022.1.5 (14.1.5), and 2023.0.1 (15.0.1), a SQL injection vulnerability has been found in the MOVEit Transfer web application that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain access to MOVEit Transfer's database.
kevVulnerabilityName: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection Vulnerability

title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Sensitive Information Disclosure (Citrix Bleed)
description: Sensitive information disclosure in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway when configured as an Appliance (Virtual Server, NetScaler Gateway, AAA Virtual Server) allows an unauthenticated attacker to extract session tokens and bypass MFA.
kevVulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
kevRequiredAction: Apply updates per vendor instructions and terminate active sessions.

title: Atlassian Confluence Data Center Broken Access Control
description: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server versions 8.0.0 through 8.5.1 allow an unauthenticated attacker to exploit broken access control vulnerability in /setup/setupadministrator.action to create unauthorized admin accounts.
kevVulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server Improper Access Control Vulnerability
kevRequiredAction: Apply updates per vendor instructions or restrict external network access.

title: Spring Framework Remote Code Execution (Spring4Shell)
description: A Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution (RCE) via data binding. The specific exploit requires the application to run on Tomcat as a WAR deployment.
kevVulnerabilityName: VMware Spring Framework Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kevRequiredAction: Upgrade to Spring Framework 5.3.18 or 5.2.20 or newer.

title: Microsoft Windows SMB Remote Code Execution (EternalBlue)
description: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets, aka 'Windows SMB Remote Code Execution Vulnerability'. Exploited by WannaCry and NotPetya.
kevVulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kevRequiredAction: Apply MS17-010 security update and disable SMBv1.

title: Apple iOS and macOS Kernel Integer Overflow (Operation Triangulation)
description: An integer overflow condition was addressed with improved input validation. An app may be able to modify sensitive kernel state. Apple is aware of a report that this issue may have been actively exploited against versions of iOS released before iOS 15.7.1.
kevVulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Integer Overflow Vulnerability

title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Management Interface Authentication Bypass
description: An authentication bypass in the management web interface of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software allows an unauthenticated administrator on the network to obtain administrative privileges.
kevVulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
kevRequiredAction: Restrict access to management interface to trusted internal IP addresses and apply software patch.

title: WinRAR File Extension Spoofing Remote Code Execution
description: RARLAB WinRAR before 6.23 allows attackers to execute arbitrary code when a user attempts to view a benign file within a ZIP archive. Attackers created archives with names matching directory names to trigger execution of executable file inside.
kevRequiredAction: Upgrade to WinRAR version 6.23 or newer.

title: Microsoft Outlook Remote Code Execution (MonikerLink)
description: Microsoft Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerability allows an attacker to bypass Protected View and execute code by sending a specially crafted hyperlink via email.
kevVulnerabilityName: Microsoft Outlook Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
kevRequiredAction: Apply Microsoft security updates for February 2024.
